android.desc:
Submind: AI Voice Notes & Voice Journal

Submind is the AI note taker that turns voice memos, meetings, and lectures into structured notes you can search, organize, and ask. Record or import audio, transcribe speech to text in 70+ languages, and get a smart note instantly — free to start.

✨ WHY SUBMIND?
🔒 Privacy & Security: Encrypted, never used for AI training.
🎙️ Voice Notes That Work: 70+ languages with auto-detect, even mid-recording.
💬 Speech to Text, Clean: Punctuation, color-coded speakers, tappable timestamps.
📥 Import Any Audio: Turn audio files you already have into text and notes.
🤖 Submind AI: Ask your notes anything. It remembers, searches the web, runs Python, and connects 100+ apps.
📝 8 Smart Note Types: Meeting, journal, interview, 1:1, lecture, consultation, basic, and brief summary.

🚀 KEY FEATURES

🎙️ RECORDING & TRANSCRIPTION
• Record voice memos up to 1 hour: live waveform, pause and resume, background recording while you use other apps or lock the screen.
• Transcribe audio to text with each speaker in a different color. Tap a line and the audio jumps to that moment.
• Turn on punctuation, filler word removal, a profanity filter, custom vocabulary, speaker identification (up to 10 speakers), and speaker name tagging.

📝 SMART NOTE TYPES
• All 8 note types are free: meeting, journal, interview, 1:1, lecture, consultation, basic, and brief summary.
• Every note is clean markdown with tappable timestamps. Switch note types and it regenerates in the new style.

📖 VOICE JOURNAL & DIARY
• Daily reflections, ideas, and moods become organized journal entries you can search and revisit.
• A private voice diary — encrypted, searchable, and easy to keep.

📥 AUDIO IMPORT (PREMIUM)
• WAV, MP3, M4A, or AAC files up to 1 hour become text, summaries, and organized notes.

🤖 SUBMIND AI (PREMIUM)
• Answers, action items, insights, and key decisions pulled from your own notes.
• Web research with tappable sources, Python in a safe sandbox, and a memory that learns from your notes.
• Connect 100+ apps like Gmail, Slack, Notion, and GitHub. You approve every action.

🌍 TRANSLATION
• Translate transcripts and notes into 45 languages, or auto-translate every new note.

🏷️ ORGANIZE & FIND
• Nested, color-coded folders and automatic tags you can rename or merge.
• Search notes, folders, and transcripts, with recent searches saved.

📤 EXPORT & SHARE
• Export recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, and conversations,
